title: Collateral Administration Manual — Substitution of a Unit Pledged to an Equipment & Vehicle Loans Loan
content:
**Provision.** On an Equipment & Vehicle Loans product that allows substitution, the member may replace one pledged unit with another unit without paying the loan down, typically when trading the unit in. A substitution is registered as a collateral substitution request naming the serial number of the unit to be replaced and the appraised value of the replacement. A unit may be pledged only while the loan is in applied status (before funding) or in active status (in substitution). The replacement unit may be no older than the product's oldest replacement age from its model year, and its value must be at least the product's replacement value percentage of the replaced unit's pledged value; when it is lower, the shortfall is paid to principal as a prepayment before the substitution is made. The replaced unit is released with the release reason substitution and the replacement is pledged the same day, its pledge pointing to that release, at the lower of its appraised value and its purchase price; one substitution fee of the product's substitution fee amount is assessed per substitution and the replacement's lien filing fee is assessed automatically with the pledge. The test of the cross-collateral clause applies. A product that does not allow substitution never substitutes; the member must sell under the release terms or pay off.

## The replacement value test

The least value a replacement must carry is the replaced unit's pledged value multiplied by the product's replacement value percentage and divided by 100, rounded to cents. Any amount by which the replacement's value falls below that figure is the shortfall paid to principal first.

**Hypothetical.** A unit pledged at 80000.00 on a New Equipment Loan (replacement value at least 100 %) is to be replaced by a unit appraised at 76000.00 and bought for 78000.00. The least value is 80000.00; the replacement's value of 76000.00 leaves a shortfall of 4000.00, paid to principal as a prepayment before the substitution. The replacement is pledged at 76000.00, the lower of its appraised value and its purchase price.

## Loan status for a pledge

| Loan status on record | A unit may be pledged |
|---|---|
| applied (before funding) | yes |
| active (in substitution) | yes |
| deferred, nonaccrual, paid off or declined | no |

## Points of judgement

- **Age of the replacement.** Hypothetical: on an Irrigation System Loan (oldest replacement 10 years), a replacement of model year 2014 is 12 years old in 2026 and does not qualify; a model year 2017 replacement, 9 years old, does.
- **Products without substitution.** On the EquipDirect Dealer Contract and the Grain Storage & Handling Loan no unit is substituted; the member sells under the release terms or pays off.
- **Charges.** One substitution fee per substitution, plus the lien filing fee for the replacement unit pledged.
